source_sha_role: rich-home source baseline before metadata refresh
source_sha_policy: Cloudflare Pages builds the governed dist artifact from main; production acceptance requires live domain, route, API and visual verification.

data_contract.policy: Evidence before amplification; every metric requires a dated snapshot; duplicate URLs collapse at runtime; private, minor, legal, financial and quarantined records are excluded from the public universe.

social_corpus.policy: Person before platform; source-linked public material; metrics only with a dated source.

release_intent: Make Cloudflare Pages the single public static source of truth for 7ya.io and present Igor as a living public record: original video, long-form audio, writing, StartOn, research, music, social posts and clearly labeled external distribution.
promotion_gate: Promote to READY only after 7ya.io and www.7ya.io resolve to the Cloudflare Pages project, the homepage serves marker 7ya-cloudflare-canonical-20260918-v1, /api/health returns canonical Cloudflare JSON, /api/feed.json serves the current feed, and critical routes pass live verification.
blockers: GitHub Actions cannot perform the automated Cloudflare cutover because GitHub has restricted metered usage after repeated PayPal billing failures; GitHub's billing email says payment information must be updated and cancelled products may need re-subscription.
The authoritative DNS still targets AppDeploy (apex 18.232.7.146; www proxy-v2.appdeploy.ai), while AppDeploy currently has no registered custom-domain records and rejects attempts to add them.

Cloudflare Pages origin is healthy at 7ya-io.pages.dev but currently serves an older successful artifact; the newest governed artifact is prepared in main and awaits a successful Pages deployment/cutover.
rollback: Prior Git commits and the last valid AppDeploy version remain available as rollback references; production routing must not use an AppDeploy catch-all proxy.
